Only CMakeLists.txt, include/, src/, LICENSE, and README.md are vendored.
Samples, tests, benchmarks, documentation, CI files, and git metadata are intentionally excluded.
Box2D is linked only by benchmark_physics2d and benchmark_physics2d_box2d; it is not a runtime backend.
